title: Corporate demand for workers with green skills rises: LinkedIn report
description:
Demand for workers with green skills is growing as businesses increasingly seek talent that can help save energy, reduce waste and operate more efficiently, according to new research from LinkedIn.
LinkedIn's Global Green Skills Report 2026 noted that demand for workers with green skills is growing almost as fast as supply in India, with the share of green hiring up 31 per cent in India compared with 29 per cent growth in the share of green talent in the workforce.
Moreover, a significant percentage of green hires in India are now going into jobs without traditionally green titles, as businesses look for workers who can help cut costs, improve efficiency and reduce their environmental impact.
"In India, a green career no longer starts with a green job title. Employers want people who can make their operations safer, leaner and more efficient, and they are hiring for that ability well beyond sustainability teams," Susan Mathew, India HR Lead, LinkedIn said.
